art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the deep green eyes looking long past the viewer, the old scar above his brow clear. Cold blue night light from one side and a white glow of fire rising from below. Foreground blur: drifting ash, leaf fragments and the faded edge of an old cloth badge. He wears the long grey-green cloak.
